name: @agentsdiagram/protocol
description: IR types (generated from the Python JSON Schema) and the viewer/extension message protocol

scripts.generate: json2ts -i ir.schema.json -o src/ir.ts --bannerComment "/* Generated from ir.schema.json by json-schema-to-typescript. Do not edit: run \`pnpm schema\` at the repo root. */" --unreachableDefinitions --additionalProperties false
scripts.check: pnpm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/ir.ts
